notes.title: For the People 1.1.3 update — full patch notes
notes.content:
We have spent the last week improving For the People and are ready to deploy another patch to make your gaming experience a breeze! The patch will be released today for all versions of the game.

Many players pointed out certain imperfections in agent missions, so we have revamped the agent appointing algorithm and added quite a bit of new content while we were at it. Here’s a shortlist of the main changes:

[list]
[*] Whereas before an agent's skills played a pivotal role in whether they were suitable for a mission, now more emphasis should be put on the individual agent's background.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Agents’ dossiers were slightly adjusted and simplified so that the player can make a decision regarding an agent faster.
[/list]
[list]
[*] We also revised the outcomes of most missions when it comes to agent failures - the descriptions will now be more definitive and detailed.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Repetitive paragraphs in the agent mission descriptions and some of the mission outcomes have been removed.
[/list]
[list]
[*] One of the repetitive citizen appeals, written by an old man complaining about the noise, can potentially affect the ending of the game.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Achievements connected to the individual districts’ opinion of the City Committee and citizen happiness will now be somewhat easier to unlock.
[/list]

Important notice: changes made to the agents will only be applied when starting a new game and will not affect existing progress.

We hope that these changes will make your gaming experience even more pleasant. As always, please continue to give us your feedback about specific For the People cases that feel excessive in this topic on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1146600/discussions/0/4325098189133146829/]Steam[/url] or in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://discord.gg/h9g48vy]Discord[/url]. Thank you for your reports and patience!

notes.title: For the People 1.0.5 update — full patch notes

tags.bug: - fixed an issue with the newspaper text being displayed incorrectly;
- applied multiple localization fixes and improvements to the Simplified Chinese version of the game.

notes.title: For the People 1.0.3 update - full patch notes

tags.bug: a large number of spelling, punctuation, and logical errors were fully fixed in both Simplified Chinese and German versions of the game;

tags.feature: when the player launches the game for the first time, it’ll now automatically open in fullscreen instead of windowed mode;

where previously your popularity among the various districts of Iron-1 was displayed in vague words (negative, indifferent, etc.) on the Citizens Attitude screen it’ll now be displayed as more precise numerical values;

tags.bug: the player can no longer pick up the black phone while the orange one is ringing;

tags.balance_change: the resource management system was largely rebalanced. The Wolfram Metallurgic Plant will consume more ore, other types of products will be consumed faster as well and the barter system will become even essential than before;
putting the plant on high alert will now have a stronger negative effect on the people’s opinion towards the City Committee;
you will no longer be able to request Copper’s help on Day 10 - the player will now need to deal with the situation themselves by employing their agents;

notes.title: For the People: Only two days left before the official launch!
notes.content:
That was a long journey but we made it to the final stretch! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1146600/For_the_People/]For the People[/url] launches in less than two days on the 13th of August and we would like to share some information regarding the latest updates and improvements that were made to the game.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1146600/For_the_People/

First and foremost - we couldn't be more grateful to our amazingly supportive community! It was an absolute blessing to get so many insightful reviews and helpful feedback from our Comrades. The team surely wouldn't be able to get this far without you!

Now let's take a closer look at the changes we made and the new features that were implemented to facilitate your enjoyment of our newest title. Those who have previously played the demo will no doubt immediately spot the difference between it and the latest version of the game. We hope you'll like it! 


[b][h3]In-game hints[/h3][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35911380/9ea5d6446e09976b9a81049893c62eaafb825f21.gif[/img]

Some users suggested implementing a system of hints that will help newcomers during their first playthrough by explaining in-game events and mechanics in greater detail. You asked for it and we have delivered - hovering the mouse cursor over certain elements of the game’s interface will now display popups with a short explanation of what these items are and how to use them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35911380/9df25765f8783e950751a3560fdc2d25d106a65e.gif[/img]


[b][h3]Save/Load menu[/h3][/b]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1146600/For_the_People/]For the People[/url] includes more than five alternate endings, so if you’re aiming to arrive at a specific conclusion to the story it's generally recommended to save your progress as often as possible - many of the player’s decisions will have serious, sometimes unforeseen consequences and may potentially alter the course of in-game history!

Don't worry though - we got you covered! Multiple additional slots have been added to the save/load menu so that you don't need to worry about missing any opportunities - simply go back in time and relive the same moment again, ultimately making a different choice.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35911380/b3a86268e98d932e10d9a00a81845a35a760ec3a.png[/img]


[h3][b]Fonts and readability[/b][/h3]

In a nutshell, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1146600/For_the_People/]For the People[/url] is an interactive novel meaning there's TONS of content for the player to read through. Never losing sight of this fact, we have readjusted the size as well as other aspects of the in-game fonts in order to improve their readability and the general accessibility of our project.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35911380/c7a4652457668c9a1d2c75994afba6a2a9a9ceb4.png[/img]


[h3][b]Recourses management and budget allocation[/b][/h3]

Some of our users pointed out that the economic planning screen could be made larger, cleaner, and easier to click around in... Well, we have heard you loud and clear! The regional management menu has seen a general overhaul, sporting not only a revised visual design but also additional hints on producing and transporting resources to and from Iron-1.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35911380/d38f1eecd07448bbe7922f694d57a8299e03aefe.gif[/img]

Public funds allocation mechanics were improved as well - instead of constantly having to keep individual districts’ needs and requests in mind or checking the status screen before making every important decision you can now simply read the reports carefully prepared by your assistant Helen!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35911380/d364d2f98a3b958e401d40e45427ba92d8e24aad.gif[/img]


[h3][b]Lore and world-building[/b][/h3]

While working on the game, our aim was to create an alternate history scenario where the ruling Orange Party has its own goals that diverge from the interests of the “proletariat.” This confrontation is at the cornerstone of the story presented in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1146600/For_the_People/]For the People[/url] and it was important to properly showcase this idea without interrupting any major game events, thus ensuring that the player can discover and explore the game’s lore at their own pace.

Should you ever feel lost or unsure about a certain term, you can now click the map hanging on the wall of Frank’s office and dive into the history of the UPOC. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35911380/27c436edb430ccde8aa53cd93162b709ac526ebb.gif[/img]

Alternatively, click the city map right in the middle of the mayor’s desk, navigate to the Anna Tietrich City Library and learn more about the main historical events, city buildings, etc.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35911380/8d7763e8676eecc034f5ce48b1c18312f16361bf.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35911380/eb8682a3141d21938e083c214d59cc387655f64a.jpg[/img]



This was just a small fraction of the changes brought on by the latest patches and updates leading up to the official Steam launch on the 13th of August.

[b]If you haven’t wishlisted and followed [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1146600/For_the_People/]For the People[/url] until now we strongly recommend you to do so in order to enjoy the delightful release day discount![/b]

We would also really appreciate it if you helped us spread the word - tell your favorite YouTuber, streamer, or a gaming media outlet about the upcoming release and feel free to share this post with your friends!
